description: We are a team of passionate developers and innovators driven by technology, space exploration, and creative problem-solving. Our skills include software and web development, UI/UX, data analysis, and coding. We welcome members interested in NASA data, AI, research, design, planetary science, and innovation. Together, we aim to learn, collaborate, and build meaningful solutions for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
MARS FARM is an interactive, NASA-data-grounded Mars agricultural planning and survival simulation built with React, TypeScript, and Three.js. We developed a deterministic bio-regenerative farming simulator where mission commanders scout six real Martian landing sites (such as Jezero Crater and Arcadia Planitia), configure crew life-support parameters, allocate greenhouse space across six specialized crop cultivars, and run a day-by-day survival simulation guided by an AI Farm Advisor.

To address the challenge of sustaining human life in deep space, MARS FARM translates verified NASA planetary datasets—including MOLA elevation, REMS meteorology, SHARAD subsurface water-ice radar, and InSight radiation measurements—into actionable agricultural metrics. Players must balance daily caloric output, closed-loop hydroponic water recycling (92–97% efficiency), and solar power budgets while responding to real Martian hazards like dust storms, solar flares, and life-support failures.

Shipping food from Earth to Mars costs over $100,000 per kilogram, and a six-astronaut crew requires over 5.4 tons of food for a 365-sol mission. By transforming complex planetary science into an interactive decision-making tool, MARS FARM bridges the gap between reaching Mars and learning how to permanently live there.
details:
WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

MARS FARM is an interactive, NASA-data-grounded Mars agricultural planning and survival simulator that answers: "If humans live on Mars, how will we feed ourselves?"

Mission commanders progress through an 8-step workflow:

1. Landing Site Reconnaissance: Explore an interactive 3D Mars globe and evaluate 6 real Martian regions (Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, Arcadia Planitia, Hellas Basin, Elysium Planitia, and Utopia Planitia). Our Suitability Engine calculates a 0–100 score weighted across water-ice potential (25%), temperature (20%), solar irradiance (15%), terrain (15%), radiation (15%), and dust risk (10%).

2. Mission Setup & Farm Engineering: Configure crew size (1–12 astronauts), duration (30–500 sols), greenhouse area (25–500 m²), water reserves, and daily solar energy budgets, then allocate hydroponic beds across 6 crop cultivars (Potato, Lettuce, Tomato, Wheat, Soybean, Carrot).

3. Day-by-Day Simulation & Crisis Resolution: Run a deterministic time-step simulation tracking daily caloric production (targeting 2,500 kcal/astronaut/sol), closed-loop water recycling (92–97% efficiency), and solar power loads while navigating 6 Martian hazards (dust storms, solar flares, water leaks, temperature drops, crop disease, and power failures).

4. Survival Scoring & Farmer AI: Receive a multi-factor Survival Score (0–100) and context-aware optimization advice from Farmer AI.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

Shipping food from Earth to Mars costs over $100,000/kg, requiring 5.4+ tons of food for a 6-person, 365-sol mission. MARS FARM makes complex bio-regenerative life-support trade-offs accessible to students, educators, and mission planners. On Earth, modeling 92–97% closed-loop hydroponic water recovery and solar-constrained crop scheduling directly informs Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) for arid, drought-stricken, and food-insecure regions.

TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

- Languages & Frontend: TypeScript 5.6, React 18.3, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS 3.4

- Build & Testing: Vite 6, ESBuild, Vitest (25 automated unit tests across 4 engine modules)

- 3D & Data Visualization: Three.js, React Three Fiber (interactive Mars globe), Recharts (real-time telemetry charts)

- Audio & AI: Web Audio API (synthesized HUD audio), Google Gemini API with deterministic local advisor fallback

- Data Sources: NASA PDS archives (MOLA, REMS, SHARAD, CRISM, InSight RAD, Mars 2020) + NASA Open APIs

HOW IT IS CREATIVE

Instead of presenting static charts of planetary data, MARS FARM turns NASA instrumentation into an interactive strategy simulation inside a futuristic Mission Control HUD. Furthermore, our "Farmer AI" advisor is architected to interpret deterministic mathematical telemetry rather than hallucinating scientific values—combining rigorous physics modeling with conversational AI coaching.

FACTORS CONSIDERED BY OUR TEAM

1. Scientific Transparency: Clearly distinguishing observed NASA measurements from "Simulation / Model Output" and documenting all baseline assumptions (0.38g gravity yield penalty, 43% Earth solar flux, 2,500 kcal/sol crew demand).

2. Zero-Downtime Reliability: Building offline-resilient fallbacks for NASA APIs, AI, and storage so the app never fails without internet or API keys.

3. Accessibility & UX: Including a 1-click "Judge Demo (3-Min)" mode, responsive layout, and reduced-motion support.
